_templateNotes: Copy this file to a new label file such as leg_extension_001.json, then edit the paths, split, expectedReps, and reps.
Use issueIds from availableIssues. Use an empty issueIds array for a clean rep.
Files named _template.json or *.template.json are ignored by dataset:evaluate and dataset:optimize.

reps.notes: Clean rep or describe the visible form issue.

notes: Draft label template. Copy to a real label file, review timings/issues, then set reviewStatus to reviewed.

availableIssues.feedbackMessage: Extend fully — straighten your legs completely at the top.
Lower the weight more — start from a deeper bend.
Keep your back against the pad — avoid leaning forward.
Keep your hips on the seat — don't lift off the pad.
Slow down the extension — control the lift.
Control the return — don't let the weight drop.
